cues.show_hands: Show both hands to the camera.
cues.right_only: Now show only your right hand.
cues.ready: Get ready. Keep both hands inside the frame.
cues.welcome: Welcome to Mira. Before we begin, how are you feeling today? Touch a face.
cues.pain_before: How much pain do you feel in your hands right now? Touch a number. Zero means no pain at all.
cues.free_play: Take a moment to get comfortable with your hands. Move them around, and look at what they do. When you are ready, touch Start session.
cues.start_hint: Whenever you are ready, touch Start session.
cues.desk: Place both hands flat on the table, and keep them still for a moment.
cues.vr_ready: Let's begin. First, we hold both hands open and still.
cues.pain_after: Well done. How much pain do you feel in your hands now?
cues.end_hint: Thank you. When you are ready, touch End session.
cues.e0: Hold both hands open, and keep them still.
cues.next_e1: Next, open and close your hands, at your own pace.
cues.e1: Open fully, then make a gentle fist.
cues.next_e2: Next, touch your thumb to each fingertip in turn. Turn your palms towards you.
cues.e2: Thumb to index, middle, ring, and little finger. Palms towards you.
cues.next_e3: Next, spread your fingers wide, then bring them together.
cues.next_e4: Last one. We will count to five on your fingers.
cues.e4: Start with a closed hand. Raise one finger for each number I say.
cues.done: All done. Well done, and thank you.
